repos.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
repos.intro: An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.
features: Open internals. Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API.
No styling lock-in. Astryx authors its styles with StyleX, but that's invisible to consumers.
Customize without wrapping. A theme is a set of CSS custom property overrides, so a designer can make Astryx unmistakably theirs without for…
Built for people and agents. The API, docs, and CLI are designed together so a person and an AI assistant build the same way, from the same…
repos.description_zh: 一個完全可自訂且已為 Agent 就緒的開源設計系統
repos.intro_zh: 一個完全可自訂，且專為現今開發模式打造的開源設計系統：由人類與與其並肩工作的 Agent 共同開發。
features_zh: 開放內部實作。組件的設計旨在任何層級進行組合，而非被鎖在封閉的高階 API 之後。
無樣式鎖定。Astryx 使用 StyleX 撰寫樣式，但這對使用者來說是透明的。
無需封裝即可自訂。主題是一組 CSS custom property 的覆寫，因此設計師可以讓 Astryx 展現出鮮明的個人風格，而不必...
為人類與 Agent 而生。API、文件與 CLI 是同步設計的，因此人類與 AI 助手能以相同的方式、從相同的...進行開發。
repos.description_src: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready

repos.description: A batteries-included framework for building web apps
repos.intro: Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack apps. It prioritizes simplicity and productivity. See Learn Topcoat to get started, or the Roadmap for what's coming next.
features: Getting started : create an app with topcoat new and run the dev server.
Manual setup : add dependencies and wire up a minimal app yourself.
Source code formatting : topcoat fmt for macro bodies.
repos.description_zh: 一個內建完整功能的 Web App 建置框架
repos.intro_zh: Topcoat 是一個模組化、內建完整功能的 Rust 框架，用於建置全端應用程式。它優先考慮簡單性與生產力。請參閱 Learn Topcoat 以開始使用，或查看 Roadmap 以了解後續規劃。
features_zh: 入門指南：使用 topcoat new 建立應用程式並執行 dev server。
手動設定：自行新增 dependencies 並串接一個最小化的應用程式。
原始碼格式化：使用 topcoat fmt 進行 macro bodies 的格式化。
repos.description_src: A batteries-included framework for building web apps

repos.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (5x fewer tokens) .上下文压缩插件，月级长会话会话， 兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token) . billion-context is all you need
repos.intro: Context-compression plugin — billion-context is all you need.
features: compress — fold a message range into a detailed summary.
decompress — restore a compressed range when exact details are needed again.
search_context — keyword search over compressed summaries and visible messages.
acp_status — context-usage overview plus which ranges are still compressible.
repos.description_zh: 一款針對長達一個月的單一 Session（數十億個 token）、小 Context Window（100K 的 context 已足夠）以及節省 token（減少 5 倍 token）所設計的 context-compression plugin。billion-context is all you need
repos.intro_zh: Context-compression plugin — billion-context is all you need。
features_zh: compress — 將一段訊息範圍摺疊成詳細的摘要。
decompress — 當需要再次查看確切細節時，還原已壓縮的範圍。
search_context — 在壓縮後的摘要與可見訊息中進行關鍵字搜尋。
acp_status — context 使用量概覽，以及哪些範圍仍可進行壓縮。
